legend: Given three numbers n,a,b%%ZSMJ0%%. You need to find an adjacency matrix of such an undirected graph that the number of components in it is equal to a%%ZSMJ1%%, and the number of components in its complement is b%%ZSMJ2%%. The matrix must be symmetric, and all digits on the main diagonal must be zeroes.
In an undirected graph loops (edges from a vertex to itself) are not allowed. It can be at most one edge between a pair of vertices.

The adjacency matrix of an undirected graph is a square matrix of size n%%ZSMJ3%% consisting only of "0" and "1", where n%%ZSMJ4%% is the number of vertices of the graph and the i%%ZSMJ5%%-th row and the i%%ZSMJ6%%-th column correspond to the i%%ZSMJ7%%-th vertex of the graph. The cell (i,j)%%ZSMJ8%% of the adjacency matrix contains 1%%ZSMJ9%% if and only if the i%%ZSMJ10%%-th and j%%ZSMJ11%%-th vertices in the graph are connected by an edge.

A connected component is a set of vertices X%%ZSMJ12%% such that for every two vertices from this set there exists at least one path in the graph connecting this pair of vertices, but adding any other vertex to X%%ZSMJ13%% violates this rule.

The complement or inverse of a graph G%%ZSMJ14%% is a graph H%%ZSMJ15%% on the same vertices such that two distinct vertices of H%%ZSMJ16%% are adjacent if and only if they are not adjacent in G%%ZSMJ17%%.
input: In a single line, three numbers are given n,a,b(1≤n≤1000,1≤a,b≤n)%%ZSMJ18%%: is the number of vertexes of the graph, the required number of connectivity components in it, and the required amount of the connectivity component in it's complement.
output: If there is no graph that satisfies these constraints on a single line, print "NO" (without quotes).

Otherwise, on the first line, print "YES"(without quotes). In each of the next n%%ZSMJ19%% lines, output n%%ZSMJ20%% digits such that j%%ZSMJ21%%-th digit of i%%ZSMJ22%%-th line must be 1%%ZSMJ23%% if and only if there is an edge between vertices i%%ZSMJ24%% and j%%ZSMJ25%% in G%%ZSMJ26%% (and 0%%ZSMJ27%% otherwise). Note that the matrix must be symmetric, and all digits on the main diagonal must be zeroes.
If there are several matrices that satisfy the conditions — output any of them.
